notes.title: The doors are OPEN
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l3vRl7C542tWNrylG/source.gif[/img]

[h1]STANDBY is live![/h1]
[b]That means that our special Prevent Cancer Foundation event with Games Done Quick is launched too.[/b]

Read about it here
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/48a4dec347106c56fb55eae763258e2960451724.jpg[/img]

[h1]Back to the news: Wallpapers and Soundtrack DLC's are available for purchase.[/h1]
By the way we've added 3 new tracks to the game recently. Let us know what you think about it ;)

Some hotfixes here:
- Speedrun timer is working properly now
- Quick Restart is active during the dash move
- Fixed pause menu text
- Fixed invisible rhombs bug
- Fixed french language

[u][b]Thanks for all the bug reports, thoughts, ideas and translation fixes, please keep it coming![/b][/u]

Ping us through:
[url=https://discord.gg/55CEJ27] our Discord channel[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/hypetraindigital]Facebook[/url]
or [url=https://twitter.com/HypeTrainD]Twitter[/url]

notes.title: The demo build was just updated!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/48ec115d5e05bb4595de8b66c1c427cec78500cc.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] The IGT timer in Speedrun mode now is continuous and won't reset or stop no matter what. 
[*] The reset button for gamepad is "back" (xbox one controller).
[*] The bug with timer being different each time is fixed.
[*] Restart SR, this is the new function that let's you to start the speedrun from level one fast, without going to the menu.
[/list]

notes.title: STANDBY Demo available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26083623/b7462e76e02865f09988b0c287a6a265827e44c7.jpg[/img]

[b] STANBY demo was released [/b] a couple days ago and will continue up until the final release in the end of September. It contains first section of levels. 

So get your reflexes ready and take the trip:

[list]
    [*]Slide your way through the spacetime with teleports
    [*]Use the entourage to outsmart the corrupted security mechanisms
    [*]Blast the obstacles away with a gun
[/list]

Remember that it’s all about an escape from the decadent, cruel but visually stunning darkish neon lit world.

We are available for discussion in comments on Steam and on  - [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/standby/156015] Gamejolt 	[/url]

Also follow us on:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/hypetraindigital/] Facebook	[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/HypeTrainD] Twitter 	[/url]

STANDBY also has a [url=standbygame.com] web-site [/url]
